title: Battle Engine Aquila
provenance: Reported by valdroff (highball-db#404, 2026-10-08), Apple M3, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.14, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r24, the environment in DXVK mode with Windows 7 and AVX advertised, the steam and vcrun2022 recipes, Emulate display mode changes on for the game, rated 5 of 5 after 5 minutes. Second report by valdroff (highball-db#413, 2026-10-08), Apple M3, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.14, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r25, the environment in Wine's own Direct3D mode with Windows 7 and AVX advertised, Emulate display mode changes on, rated 5 of 5 after 21 minutes, with a performance problem on the Wine 11 engine. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Reported perfect on the default Wine 10 engine twice, once in DXVK mode over 5 minutes and once in Wine's own Direct3D mode over 21 minutes, both with Emulate display mode changes on, without which the game's resolution was wrong. The same player found it slow on the Wine 11 engine. Both modes worked, so the page sets no mode. No measurement here yet.

knownIssues.cause: not measured. The game changes the display mode, which the Mac doesn't do for Windows programs.
knownIssues.fix: On the game's page, open Game settings and tick Emulate display mode changes.
Use the default Wine 10 engine, where it plays well.
